Subject: West Coast Customer Summit — venue quote + requested PO ceiling

Hi team,

Attached is the signed quote from Lakeside Venue for the West Coast Customer Summit (LA) — event date Sept 21, 2026. High level: venue rental + basic AV + staffing = $35,200. Lakeside requires a 30% deposit to secure the date (attached schedule shows deposit of $10,560).

Sponsor update: Amentum Partners has committed $8k toward venue offset (see sponsorship commitment PDF). Net expected company spend = $27,200.

Asking: approval to create a PO for $35,200 with a finance spend ceiling of $40,000 to cover incidental vendor add-ons (catering quoted separately) and to route the deposit ($10,560) via PCard or PO (finance preference?). Please confirm:
- cost center and GL code to map to
- whether PCard is acceptable for the deposit or if we should route via PO (vendor prefers PO)
- any VP-level approval needed for this spend ceiling

Attachments: LSV_quote_051026.pdf, venue_deposit_schedule.xlsx, amentum_sponsorship_commitment.pdf

Thanks — I’d like to lock the venue this week if possible.

Best,
Marissa

1) Can you send a line-item breakdown (rental / AV / security / insurance) and the vendor W9/insurance cert?
2) For cost center please propose one — my preference is MK-EVENTS-2026 (cost center 5120). If finance prefers a numeric code I can accept their mapping.
3) Confirm the sponsor payment timing (will Lakeside invoice us for full amount and we invoice sponsor separately, or will sponsor pay Lakeside directly?)

If the net company spend is $27,200 and deposit is $10,560, I’m comfortable starting the PO for the full venue amount and tagging the sponsor credit. I’ll forward to Avery for VP approval if Naomi says this requires VP sign-off.

-Jordan

Subject: Re: West Coast Customer Summit — finance routing and PO policy

Hi all,

Thanks for the context — a few finance items before we generate a PO:

• PO vs PCard: Lakeside prefers PO. For deposits > $10k we typically require PO routing to maintain audit trail. Deposit here is $10,560 — borderline. Please proceed with PO.
• Approvals: company policy requires VP approval for any single-event vendor commitment > $25,000. Since the gross venue amount is $35,200 (even with sponsor offset), please loop in your VP to approve the spend ceiling.
• Documentation: we need vendor W9 and COI (certificate of insurance). Please upload to the Event folder in Drive and attach a link.
• GL mapping: use cost center MK-EVENTS-2026 and GL code 6540 (Events & Sponsorship). Finance will code sponsor credits in a separate journal entry once invoices come in.

Once you have VP approval I’ll create the PO in Coupa and attach payment terms. If you want the deposit released immediately after PO creation let me know and I’ll set payment terms to Net 30 with an invoice hold release for deposit.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

• Sponsor payment: Amentum will remit payment directly to Lakeside within 30 days of invoice (they indicated direct pay on their commitment). We will note sponsor payment on the PO as an offset so finance can net it out on our ledger.
• Breakdown (line items): Rental $18,000; AV $9,200; Security & staffing $5,000; Insurance/admin $2,000; Total $34,200 (+ service fees = $35,200 on final). See venue_deposit_schedule.xlsx for the full schedule and deposit timeline.

I have uploaded: LSV_quote_051026.pdf, venue_deposit_schedule.xlsx, amentum_sponsorship_commitment.pdf to the event Drive folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3EventDocs

Requesting VP approval now — forwarding to Jordan to loop in Avery.

—Marissa

1) Cap speaker/travel reimbursements to $1,500 per external speaker unless pre-cleared by me.
2) Any catering add-ons that push the total venue-related spend above $42,000 require re-approval.
3) Finance should create the PO for the full $35,200 and mark Amentum as an external credit on the invoice. We will reconcile once sponsor remits payment.

Jordan/Marissa — please confirm the final invoice flow (vendor -> Redwood with sponsor credited, or vendor -> sponsor directly) in writing.
